title: Automatically rediscover Gemini choices in a picker that is already open
outcome: An already-open Gemini settings picker can request fresh capabilities after its catalog is invalidated, while keeping the manual refresh path and unavailable states accurate.
acceptance: An already-open picker requests discovery when its formerly valid catalog is invalidated and the current session is eligible.
Ordinary updates with an unavailable catalog do not create repeated refreshes. Busy sessions respect the existing idle refresh boundary.
